title: The approval desk
hook: Toy decisions pass through one approval desk. What if capacity is redistributed?

knows: basic arithmetic and the meaning of a percentage
doesNotKnow: Recompute the complete decision chain after authority and processing capacity are redistributed.

misconception: Removing central approval means the resulting decision process has no remaining constraints.
objective: Recompute the complete decision chain after authority and processing capacity are redistributed.

claims.text: Original stipulated flow model: A inputs [12, 2, 12] yield 2; B inputs [6, 8, 6] yield 6. Prediction correct option 6.00. Every decision needs all three steps. A completes {A} decisions/hour; B completes {B}. B’s approval handles eight, but preparation and action each cap completions at six. Knowledge quality, military operations and leadership outcomes are not modeled. Question premise: Each decision needs Prepare, Approve and Act. B handles 6, 8 and 6 decisions/hour at those steps. How many completed decisions per hour can B sustain?

claims.text: A toy decision chain prepares 9, approves 12 and acts on 5 decisions/hour. Completed decisions/hour? Every completed decision needs all three steps, so min(9,12,5) = 5.
